THEME DETAILS & PLUGIN REQUIREMENTS

Veloura Beauty Pro.

An original luxury WordPress theme concept for salons, spas, estheticians, skincare studios, and boutique personal-care businesses.

What's included

The installable theme is a classic PHP-based WordPress theme (not a Full Site Editing block theme). It includes homepage templates, services, FAQ, editorial sections, a blog, page, archive, search, and 404 layouts, plus original demo imagery.

  • WordPress theme files: PHP, CSS, JavaScript, images, and README
  • WordPress Customizer settings for several homepage headings and hero CTA text
  • Primary/footer menu locations, optional custom logo, post featured images, blog/sidebar support
  • Responsive layout and reduced-motion styling

Platform and hosting

Built for a compatible self-hosted WordPress installation. WordPress hosting and a domain are not included. This is not a standalone HTML template or a native Site Editor block theme.

Visual media

Three AI-generated concept images are supplied for the demo: salon interior, stylist session, and skincare still life. No real business or client results are represented.

Plugin requirements

The base visual theme can run without third-party plugins. Additional functionality requires separate plugin installation and configuration by the buyer.

FeatureRequirement
Base theme layout, pages, FAQNone
Inquiry/contact formOptional plugin, but required if a working inquiry form is desired: Forminator, Contact Form 7, or Fluent Forms
Real appointment schedulingOptional plugin, but required if online booking is desired: Amelia or Simply Schedule Appointments
Online salesWooCommerce or another commerce solution; integration and theme compatibility must be separately tested

Important: No plugin is bundled. The theme's homepage currently contains an informational booking/shortcode placeholder, not a live plugin embed. Connecting and validating a real form or booking workflow is additional setup work.

Installation overview

After purchasing the private installation ZIP, go to WordPress Admin → Appearance → Themes → Add New → Upload Theme. Activate the theme, choose your homepage and menus, then edit the available hero fields in Appearance → Customize.

Replace all sample branding, business details, and stock/demo content. If appointments or forms are needed, install the selected plugin, create the form/calendar, configure notifications, then integrate and test it.

Prelaunch status: This theme package is not yet WordPress-installation tested in a complete production-like environment. It's a preview, not a purchase-ready listing. Pricing and checkout are not enabled.
